notes.title: Let's celebrate World Animal Day with Animal Week! 🥳
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h3]

[h2]We are excited to announce that our game is a part of [b]Animal Week on Steam, starting today until October 10, 2024! 😻[/b][/h2] 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/GamesIncubator/sale/AnimalWeek][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666157/acbfcdb9ad6540118cb53041410bc50decc2f9e8.png[/img][/url]

This special event is organized to celebrate [b]World Animal Day[/b] and aims to raise awareness about animal welfare and conservation. During [b]Animal Week[/b], our game will be featured alongside a diverse selection of animal-themed games, offering players unique experiences that highlight the beauty and importance of the animals and environment worldwide.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2658510/view/4660753243321301287

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/GamesIncubator/sale/AnimalWeek][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666157/6407467d84d8cac0ff8bec4fca835c71f4296b0d.png[/img][/url]

We are proud to support efforts to protect wildlife and their habitats by participating in this event. This initiative promises to provide an educational and entertaining experience for all players. 🤝

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/eb19fe493d76b11305b4420230767da78aeeadac.png[/img]

[h3][b]As part of our commitment, a portion of the revenue generated from our game during Animal Week will be donated to animal welfare organizations. 🥰[/b][/h3]

[url=https://www.wwf.pl/pomagam/adopcje/tygrys?utm_source=STEAM&utm_medium=banner&utm_campaign=steam+WWF][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/e7160665a65210e6cdcc6e8bb638baef925e3d4a.png[/img][/url]

The [b]main partner of Animal Week[/b] is [b]WWF Poland[/b], a leading conservation organization, that brings their [b]extensive expertise in wildlife protection and environmental sustainability.[/b] Their involvement in this event underscores the shared commitment of both organizations to foster a deeper understanding of animal conservation issues among the gaming community.

[h3][b]Read more about helping the TIGER 🐯 click the banner below 👇[/b][/h3]
[url=https://www.wwf.pl/pomagam/adopcje/tygrys?utm_source=STEAM&utm_medium=banner&utm_campaign=steam+WWF][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/0f02d1c40abac7b658288ca99db9557afc693ce7.png[/img][/url]

[h2][b]Think globally act locally 🌍[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Let’s make a difference together through the power of gaming! 🦸‍♂️🦸‍♂️[/b][/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/91f3a34156d093b6bf3cf365dcaa294e9aff9a56.png[/img]

Have Fun!!
Games Incubator Team

notes.title: Update #5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Interaction with items is more flexible. There will no longer be a situation where an interaction failed notification is shown when trying to fill a bowl
[*] You can no longer interact with items through the wall
[*] Playing with the cat has been simplified a bit. Cat jumps on the feathers more slowly
[*] Fixed picking up newspapers lying on the floor. You don't have to destroy the floor to pick up the newspapers
[*] Improved employee interaction with the microwave. Employee should no longer get stuck when trying to interact with the microwave
[*] Animal needs don't increase so much with change of day
[/list]

notes.title: Update #4
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug with textures that caused the performance to drop to 1 fps on some devices
- Made partial corrections to translations
- Reduced the size of the game on disk
- Customers first come to pick up pets and then hand them over so that swaping animals to the same room on the same day can be possible
- Added light volumetric mist
- Disabled next tutorial button in last tutorial

notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] During free play, a tooltip on how to open the tablet is displayed all the time
[*] In buy walls, floor or roof mode with the camera from above enabled, you can change floors with the PageUp and PageDown keys
[*] Temporarily disabled step simulation on the camera, the camera will not move up and down
[*] You can place rooms on grass, but they will still require a floor to function
[*] Lamps saves that they are on or off and will remain so after loading the game
[*] Dog should no longer stop behind a wall when the player interacts with the tub faster than the dog on leash can reach the player
[*] A notification appears if the player tries to assign a function to a key that is already assigned to another function
[/list]

Thank you very much to everyone for suggestions and reporting bugs, thanks to you the game can be better and better :)

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
This is just a small update that fixes the following issues:

[list]
[*] Employees will not spawn a million times after changing their working hours after they have finished their shift
[*] Fixed an issue where a wall could not be sold if there was an object hanging near it but not specifically on it
[/list]

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The cat will no longer teleport to the claw trimmer station after being placed in his room
[*] Drying with a dryer should no longer stutter
[*] You can close the door by clicking on the actual door
[*] Manager's desk and registration desks take up more space so that there is always room for employees and customers
[*] The show notes button on the pet registration computer is more noticeable
[/list]

notes.title: Massaging the Hotel attenders😺
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Pets Hotel Owners![/b] 🐶[/h1]
Today we are gonna go over the [b]massage[/b] service you will be able to provide for your favorite animals!🐢❤

[h1][b]Massage[/b]🥰[/h1]
[b]Masseuses[/b] need to be called in to their [b]stations[/b] every time there is a job for them📞

Items used only by your workers will be marked accordingly in the shop🎀

If you have 10 [b]pets[/b] and 6 of them have to be [b]massaged[/b] you will need to call a specialist for the job to take care of the [b]pets[/b] one by one.👩‍🏫

Everything to make your [b]pets[/b] feel loved and cared for🥰

[h1][b]Special service[/b]💅🏻[/h1]
When the client calls there is going to be a window that will appear, informing you about the details of an animal and displaying an additional service like a [b]massage[/b]🙀 that the client may want to be performed.🤳

If the player bought [b]equipment[/b] letting him do that service he can accept the [b]pet[/b].💲✅

For the special [b]service[/b] you have to buy [b]special equipment[/b] and set it up in its designated place.👨‍🏫

We hope you will have a lot of fun with these special services added to the game! Let us know what you think about it in our [b]Discord[/b]! (link below) Don’t forget to wishlist the game to get the freshest [b]devlogs[/b] delivered right under your doorstep!  ✨

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714250/Pets_Hotel/

Massage you soon!
The Pets Hotel Team
